## Sober Girl (consumer app and guides)

Sober Girl is a private sobriety tracker for women, made by Ship AI Lab (Ship AI Solutions, LLC). It counts sober days and money saved, with a daily check-in, a Craving SOS (breathing exercise and 10-minute timer), milestone badges and a tree that grows as you stay sober. Core tools are free; Plus adds a private journal, mood insights and shareable milestone cards. Available on Google Play for Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sobergirl.app); the iPhone version is coming soon. It is not treatment and has not been tested in a published trial.

App page: https://shipailab.com/sobergirl
Guides hub: https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/guides

## Nerra (GLP-1 companion app and guides)

Nerra is a private GLP-1 companion app for iPhone, made by Hicham Zaidi. It tracks the doses you enter, injection sites with rotation, weight and body measurements, and daily check-ins for nausea, appetite and energy. No account and no cloud, so data stays on the device. Core logging is free; Nerra Lifetime is a one-time purchase with no subscription. It is not a medical device and never calculates or suggests a dose. Coming soon to the App Store, in English and German. Nerra's guides cite the manufacturers' US prescribing information for Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound.

- [Nerra guides hub](https://shipailab.com/nerra/guides): All Nerra GLP-1 guides and free tools.
- [GLP-1 Injection Site Rotation: Free Planner + What the Labels Say](https://shipailab.com/nerra/glp-1-injection-site-rotation): Where to inject Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound, what each label says about rotating sites, and a free printable 12-week site rotation planner.
